name: agoodley/librenms-inventory-plugin
description: LibreNMS plugin: inventory reports across the network from what LibreNMS already collects (models and software versions, device and module serial numbers, optics by type, vendor, model and wavelength, a serial number search, CSV exports, a panel on each device page) and software compliance: approved, minimum and blocked versions per model or OS, checked every hour, with findings in the eventlog and a history of the upgrades
